claim.raw_value: by mutual written consent of the Company and Parent

if any Governmental Entity having jurisdiction over any Party shall have issued any order, decree, ruling or injunction or taken any other action permanently restraining, enjoining or otherwise prohibiting the consummation of the Merger and such order, decree, ruling or injunction or other action shall have become final and nonappealable
if there shall be adopted any Law that permanently makes consummation of the Merger illegal or otherwise permanently prohibited
if the Merger shall not have been consummated on or before 5:00 p.m. Houston time, on April 30, 2021
if the Merger shall not have been consummated on or before 5:00 p.m. Houston time, on April 30, 2021(such date, the “End Date”)
in the event of a breach by the other Party of any representation, warranty, covenant or other agreement contained in this Agreement
thirty (30) days after the giving of written notice to the breaching Party of such breach
two (2) Business Days prior to the End Date
the Company Stockholder Approval shall not have been obtained upon a vote held at a duly held Company Stockholders Meeting, or at any adjournment or postponement thereof
the Parent Stockholder Approval shall not have been obtained upon a vote held at a duly held Parent Stockholders Meeting, or at any adjournment or postponement thereof
if the Company Board or a committee thereof shall have effected a Company Change of Recommendation
if the Parent Board or a committee thereof shall have effected a Parent Change of Recommendation
if the Company, its Subsidiaries or any of the Company’s directors or executive officers shall have Willfully and Materially Breached the obligations set forth in Section 6.3(b)
if Parent, its Subsidiaries or any of Parent’s directors or executive officers shall have Willfully and Materially Breached the obligations set forth in Section 6.4(b)
permanently restraining, enjoining or otherwise prohibiting the consummation of the Merger and such order, decree, ruling or injunction or other action shall have become final and nonappealable

attributes.why_unmapped: RESTRAINT_FINALITY: Governmental restraint/injunction must be permanent and must have become final and nonappealable to support termination.

claim.raw_value: permanently makes consummation of the Merger illegal or otherwise permanently prohibited

attributes.why_unmapped: RESTRAINT_FINALITY: An adopted Law must permanently make the Merger illegal or otherwise permanently prohibited to support termination.

claim.raw_value: which would give rise to the failure of a condition set forth in Sections 7.2(a) or (b) or Section 7.3(a) or (b), as applicable

attributes.why_unmapped: BREACH_STANDARD: The breach must be of a nature that would cause failure of the closing conditions in Sections 7.2(a)/(b) or 7.3(a)/(b) to be terminable.

claim.raw_value: prior to, but not after, the time the Company Stockholder Approval is obtained

attributes.why_unmapped: PRE_VOTE_LIMIT: Parent's right to terminate for a Company Change of Recommendation may only be exercised before the Company Stockholder Approval is obtained.

claim.raw_value: prior to, but not after, the time the Parent Stockholder Approval is obtained

attributes.why_unmapped: PRE_VOTE_LIMIT: The Company's right to terminate for a Parent Change of Recommendation may only be exercised before the Parent Stockholder Approval is obtained.

claim.raw_value: shall have Willfully and Materially Breached the obligations set forth in Section 6.3(b)

attributes.why_unmapped: BREACH_STANDARD: The Company's no-solicitation breach termination requires a willful and material breach of Section 6.3(b).

claim.raw_value: shall have Willfully and Materially Breached the obligations set forth in Section 6.4(b)

attributes.why_unmapped: BREACH_STANDARD: Parent's no-solicitation breach termination requires a willful and material breach of Section 6.4(b).

claim.raw_value: provided, however, that the right to terminate this Agreement under this Section 8.1(b)(i) shall not be available to any Party whose failure to fulfill any material covenant or agreement under this Agreement has been the cause of or resulted in the action or event described in this Section 8.1(b)(i) occurring

attributes.why_unmapped: a fault-based carve-out barring a party whose own covenant breach caused the legal restraint from invoking this termination right; resembles a qualification on the LEGAL_RESTRAINT RIGHT_GRANT but is not itself a trigger, party-scope, or cure fact

claim.raw_value: provided, however, that the right to terminate this Agreement under this Section 8.1(b)(ii) shall not be available to any Party whose failure to fulfill any material covenant or agreement under this Agreement has been the cause of or resulted in the failure of the Merger to occur on or before such date

attributes.why_unmapped: a fault-based carve-out barring a party whose own covenant breach caused the Merger's non-consummation from invoking the OUTSIDE_DATE termination right; resembles a qualification on the RIGHT_GRANT but is not itself a trigger, party-scope, or deadline fact

claim.raw_value: provided, however, that the terminating Party is not then in Terminable Breach of any representation, warranty, covenant or other agreement contained in this Agreement

attributes.why_unmapped: a clean-hands qualification barring a terminating party that is itself in Terminable Breach from exercising the BREACH termination right; resembles BREACH_STANDARD but is a party-eligibility condition rather than a statement of what constitutes a breach

claim.raw_value: (whether or not such Company Change of Recommendation is permitted by this Agreement)

attributes.why_unmapped: clarifies that Parent's termination right for a Company Change of Recommendation applies regardless of whether that change was itself permitted under the Agreement; resembles a qualifier on the RECOMMENDATION_CHANGE RIGHT_GRANT but is not itself a trigger, party, or deadline fact

claim.raw_value: (whether or not such Parent Change of Recommendation is permitted by this Agreement)

attributes.why_unmapped: clarifies that the Company's termination right for a Parent Change of Recommendation applies regardless of whether that change was itself permitted under the Agreement; resembles a qualifier on the RECOMMENDATION_CHANGE RIGHT_GRANT but is not itself a trigger, party, or deadline fact

claim.raw_value: A terminating Party shall provide written notice of termination to the other Party specifying with particularity the reason for such termination and any termination shall be effective immediately upon delivery of such written notice to the other Party.

attributes.why_unmapped: States the mechanics and immediate effectiveness of a termination notice under Section 8.1, resembling a CURE_PERIOD notice-delivery window but containing no day count, so it cannot be typed as a CURE_PERIOD assertion.

claim.raw_value: no such termination shall relieve any Party from liability for any damages for a Willful and Material Breach of any covenant, agreement or obligation hereunder or fraud

attributes.why_unmapped: A post-termination liability survival carve-out naming a Willful and Material Breach standard, but it governs surviving liability after termination rather than the standard for exercising a termination right itself, so it is not clearly a BREACH_STANDARD mechanic.
